events.label: Uncle Jim raises allowance for diary; dies
events.description: Danny's mysterious Uncle Jim, who always had money and time for the boy, pays him a small allowance on condition he keeps a diary - then dies, leaving the way clear.

events.label: Danny inherits Time-belt
events.description: Among his inheritance, young Danny finds a strange, clunky device: a Time-belt that can throw its wearer anywhere in time he pleases.

events.label: Meets future self Don; races win
events.description: Using the belt, Danny runs into a confident older stranger called Don - who is Danny himself, grown up, come back to walk his younger self through the ropes.

events.label: Danny becomes Don guiding yesterday's self
events.description: In time Danny grows into Don himself and returns to guide the boy he used to be, an endless circle of elder self teaching younger self.

events.label: Ever more alternate Daniels (ultra-Don…)
events.description: The time-hopping multiplies: more and more Daniels at every age appear, from adolescents to the ancient ultra-Don, until the boy's life is crowded with versions of himself.

events.label: Changes erase traces of childhood
events.description: As the Daniels reshuffle their own history, Danny finds his childhood softly slipping away - his mother now remembers a daughter, and the boy he was is fading from the record.

events.label: Meets female counterpart Diane / Donna mirrors
events.description: Danny meets Diane, a female counterpart from another branch of possibilities - another child of the same experiment, living the mirror version of his life.

events.label: Diane pregnant; each forces child's sex → closed parental loops
events.description: Diane becomes pregnant by one of the Daniels; with time travel they can choose the child's parentage and sex, so Daniel and Diane end up as the child's mother and father both.

events.label: Aging Daniel realizes he is Uncle Jim
events.description: Aging Daniel finally understands the truth he has been circling all along: Uncle Jim, the benefactor who started it all, is himself, come back old.

events.label: Arranges inheritance so diary and belt restart experience
events.description: As Uncle Jim, Daniel arranges his own inheritance - the money, the allowance, the diary - so that the boy he was will start the whole journey again.

events.label: 1999 house party of dozens of ages of Daniel
events.description: In 1999 the Daniels throw themselves a party: dozens of versions of one man, every age from teenager to ancient, drinking and arguing under one roof.

events.label: Elderly jump-death confronts mortality
events.description: When one aged Daniel dies during a leap, the others come face to face with the fact that, however many of them there are, each one dies alone.

events.label: Young Daniel, diary complete, must choose whether to use belt
events.description: Young Daniel, diary complete, stands at the beginning of everything and must decide whether to put the belt on at all - knowing full well what it will make of his life.

events.label: Time belt inheritance
events.description: A boy inherits a time belt from a mysterious uncle, and a single twist of the buckle can send him to any when he likes.

events.label: Meets other selves
events.description: With the belt, Daniel keeps meeting himself - friendly Don, wild alternate Daniels, a whole family of one.

events.label: Relationships with variants
events.description: Among the many selves, Daniel finds love with Diane, his female counterpart - a romance only time travel could arrange, and only time travel could complicate.

events.label: Time wars among selves
events.description: The Daniels don't always agree; factions and fights break out among the versions, 'time wars' of one man against his own many selves.

events.label: Belt origin paradox
events.description: The belt itself has no maker: it was passed on from self to self, an object whose origin is swallowed by the loop it creates.

events.label: Aging continuum of selves
events.description: From boy to elder, the Daniels form a whole continuum of ages, each looking forward or backward at the others like rungs on a ladder.

events.label: Identity multiplicity theme
events.description: When every companion is yourself, the book asks who 'you' even is - Daniel's identity spreads thin across a crowd of Daniels.

events.label: Final solitude among selves
events.description: For all the crowd of selves, the story closes on solitude: in the end, Daniel is alone with the only company he ever really had - himself.

ruleEffects.effect: Belt, diary, Uncle Jim, and son all lack external origin outside Daniel loops
Role rotation forces each Daniel to enact the meetings he remembers

outcome.summary: Extreme self-society via Time-belt; parental and uncle bootstraps close; young Daniel faces the choice to begin.
